services.name: Structural
services.title: Crawl space &
services.intro: Sagging floors, soft spots and cracked piers rarely fix themselves. We find the cause, repair the structure under your home, and leave it stronger and drier than we found it.

cover.alt: New block pier and beam installed under a sagging floor

services.coverCaption: New block pier and beam under a sagging floor.
services.seoDescription: Crawl space and foundation repair in Winston-Salem and the Triad: sagging floors, rotted joists, failing piers and sill plates, fixed at the cause.

signs.heading: Signs it’s time to
signs.intro: Most foundation problems show up inside the house first. If you notice any of these, it’s worth having someone crawl under and take a look.
items: Floors that sag, bounce or slope
Doors and windows that start to stick
A musty smell or damp air inside
Standing water, mold or wet insulation under the house

work.heading: What we
work.intro: We fix the cause, not just the symptom. If water is what’s rotting the joists, we deal with the water too.
items: Sistering and replacing damaged joists and beams
New block piers and support posts, set plumb and level
Sill plate and rim joist repair
Vapor barriers, encapsulation and sealed ductwork
Drainage that keeps water out from under the house

process.heading: How a repair
process.body: Kerney walks the crawl space with you, takes photos, and shows you exactly what he found, including what doesn’t need fixing. You get one written price before any work starts. The crew does the work, cleans up every day, and walks the finished job with you before we call it done.

services.name: Water & moisture
services.title: Water &
services.intro: Water under or around a house doesn’t stay put. It soaks into framing, feeds mold and works its way into the foundation. We find where it’s coming from, stop it, and keep the crawl space dry.

cover.alt: Encapsulated crawl space with a white vapor barrier

services.coverCaption: Crawl space sealed wall to wall.
services.seoDescription: Crawl space encapsulation, vapor barriers, French drains and basement waterproofing in Winston-Salem and the Triad.

signs.heading: Signs water is
signs.intro: You’ll usually smell it or feel it before you see it.
items: A musty smell inside the house
Damp air, sweating ducts or wet insulation under the floor
Standing water in the crawl space after a rain
Water pooling against the foundation or by the downspouts
Mold or white staining on joists and block

work.heading: What we
work.intro: We start with where the water comes from, then seal up what’s left so it stays dry.
items: Vapor barriers sealed to the walls and piers

process.heading: How the work
process.body: Kerney looks under the house and around it, finds where the water is getting in, and shows you photos of what he found. You get one written price before any work starts. We fix the source first, then seal the crawl space, clean up every day, and walk the finished job with you.
